info.name: AgroTrust API
info.description: Full HTTP surface of the AgroTrust platform (84+ routes). See postman/README.md in the project for setup instructions, required manual steps (role grants, crop seeding), and recommended run order. Folders are numbered in the order they should be run top-to-bottom for a coherent end-to-end walkthrough.

item.name: Login admin (run AFTER granting PLATFORM_ADMIN - see README)
Login lender (run AFTER granting LENDER role - see README)
Login agent (run AFTER granting FIELD_AGENT role - see README)
Fund order (buyer - needs wallet balance, see Payments folder first)
Cancel order (optional branch - only before PREPARING)
[DEV] Get webhook signature for a body
Submit payment webhook (as the real gateway would)
